code: crossprod_R_impl <- function(x, y) {     # t(X) %*% y     s <- 1 / x@col_scales     c_vec <- x@col_locations      x_tb <- numeric(ncol(x@data))     sum_y <- base::sum(y)      for (j in seq_len(ncol(x@data))) {       x_tb[j] <- s[j] * base::sum(x@data[, j] * y) -                  s[j] * c_vec[j] * sum_y     }     return(matrix(x_tb, ncol = 1)) } bench_crossprod <- function(sparse_matrix, b) {   X <- LazyMatrix(sparse_matrix, "sd", "mean")   bm <- bench::mark(     r_cross_product = {       crossprod_R_impl(X, b)     },     rcpp_cross_product = {       crossprod(X, b)     },     check = FALSE,     min_iterations = 20   )   bm } set.seed(123) test_vector <- rnorm(nrow(m_small)) bm_cp_small <- bench_crossprod(m_small, test_vector) bm_cp_small[c("expression", "min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")] #> # A tibble: 2 × 5 #>   expression              min   median `itr/sec` mem_alloc #>   <bch:expr>         <bch:tm> <bch:tm>     <dbl> <bch:byt> #> 1 r_cross_product      4.17ms   5.65ms      193.  632.67KB #> 2 rcpp_cross_product  16.77µs   18.5µs    49795.    8.27KB set.seed(123) large_vector <- rnorm(nrow(m_large)) bm_cp_large <- bench_crossprod(m_large, large_vector) bm_cp_large[c("expression", "min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")] #> # A tibble: 2 × 5 #>   expression              min   median `itr/sec` mem_alloc #>   <bch:expr>         <bch:tm> <bch:tm>     <dbl> <bch:byt> #> 1 r_cross_product      59.7ms   60.9ms      16.4    10.9MB #> 2 rcpp_cross_product   21.3µs   22.9µs   41824.       11KB if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE) &&     requireNamespace("ggbeeswarm", quietly = TRUE) &&     requireNamespace("gridExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {    p1 <- plot(bm_cp_small)   p2 <- plot(bm_cp_large)    gridExtra::grid.arrange(   p1, p2,   ncol = 2,   top = "Microbenchmark for Small(n=500, p=50) and Large(n=1000, p=700) Sparse Matrices" ) }

\alpha_1 \mathbf{u}_1, \\ \beta_2 &= \sqrt{\sum \mathbf{\beta}_u^2}, \\ \mathbf{u}_2 &= \frac{\mathbf{\beta}_u}{\beta_2}, \\ \mathbf{\alpha}_v &= \mathbf{}^\top \mathbf{u}_2 - \beta_2 \mathbf{v}_1, \\ \alpha_2 &= \sqrt{\sum \mathbf{\alpha}_v^2}, \\ \mathbf{v}_2 &= \frac{\mathbf{\alpha}_v}{\alpha_2}. \end{align*} Construct apply next orthogonal transformation: ρ1=(ρ1‾)2+β22,c1=ρ1‾ρ1,s1=β2ρ1,θ2=s1α2,ρ2‾=−c1α2,ϕ1=c1ϕ1‾,ϕ2‾=s1ϕ1‾.\begin{align*} \rho_1 &= \sqrt{(\bar{\rho_1})^2 + \beta_2^2}, \\ c_1 &= \frac{\bar{\rho_1}}{\rho_1}, \\ s_1 &= \frac{\beta_2}{\rho_1}, \\ \theta_2 &= s_1 \alpha_2, \\ \bar{\rho_2} &= -c_1 \alpha_2, \\ \phi_1 &= c_1\bar{\phi_1}, \\ \bar{\phi_2} &= s_1 \bar{\phi_1}. \end{align*} Update 𝐱\mathbf{x} 𝐰\mathbf{w}: 𝐱1=𝐱0+ϕ1ρ1𝐰1,𝐰2=𝐯2−θ2ρ1𝐰1.\begin{align*} \mathbf{x}_1 &= \mathbf{x}_0 + \frac{\phi_1}{\rho_1} \mathbf{w}_1, \\ \mathbf{w}_2 &= \mathbf{v}_2 - \frac{\theta_2}{\rho_1} \mathbf{w}_1. \end{align*} Reset loop variables: β1=β2,𝐮1=𝐮2,α1=α2,𝐯1=𝐯2,ρ1‾=ρ2‾,ϕ1‾=ϕ2‾,𝐱0=𝐱1,𝐰1=𝐰2.\begin{align*} \beta_1 &= \beta_2, \\ \mathbf{u}_1 &= \mathbf{u}_2, \\ \alpha_1 &= \alpha_2, \\ \mathbf{v}_1 &= \mathbf{v}_2, \\ \bar{\rho_1} &= \bar{\rho_2}, \\ \bar{\phi_1} &= \bar{\phi_2}, \\ \mathbf{x}_0 &= \mathbf{x}_1, \\ \mathbf{w}_1 &= \mathbf{w}_2. \end{align*} Check convergence. point, authors propose criterion stop iterating. code: gradient_descent_helper <- function(   x,   y,   w_init,   b_init,   learning_rate,   n_epochs ) {   w <- w_init   b <- Matrix::Matrix(b_init, nrow = nrow(x))   n <- nrow(x)   for (epoch in 1:n_epochs) {     y_pred <- x %*% w + b     error <- y_pred - y     w <- w - (learning_rate * crossprod(x, error)) / n     b <- b - (learning_rate * sum(error)) / n   }   list(w = w, b = b) } set.seed(4567)   p <- ncol(X)   w_init <- stats::rnorm(p)   b_init <- stats::rnorm(1)   y_true <- stats::rnorm(nrow(A))   learning_rate <- 0.01   n_epochs <- 10 pars_lazy <- gradient_descent_helper(    x = X,    y = y_true,    w_init = w_init,    b_init = b_init,    learning_rate = learning_rate,    n_epochs = n_epochs   ) print("First 5 parameter weights and the bias term.") #> [1] "First 5 parameter weights and the bias term." print(pars_lazy$w[1:5]) #> [1] -0.6537508 -0.7836177  0.2716844  0.5295553  1.2169584 print(pars_lazy$b[1]) #> [1] 1.381793
